_comment: Plan Area J WP5. Every high/critical npm advisory is fixed or listed here with a reason, an owner and an expiry. An expired entry fails the build again. Review the api entries when Prisma ships a release whose CLI no longer depends on the affected packages.

exceptions.reason: Reaches the advisories below only through the Prisma CLI (dev/deploy tooling). The app talks to PostgreSQL only and never runs the CLI on untrusted input. The suggested fix downgrades Prisma 7 to 6 (breaking).
Transitive of the Prisma CLI (deepmerge-ts); see the prisma entry.
Stack exhaustion on recursive object graphs; only reachable by feeding the Prisma CLI a hostile config, which no code path does.
MySQL protocol issues; this system uses PostgreSQL only and never opens a MySQL connection.
